purpose: Define nanoCMS as the owner of canonical web structure (#WEB): site hierarchy, pages, routes, navigation metadata and MetaModule placement/bindings, but not MetaModule semantics.

does_not_own: runtime execution authority unless explicitly referenced

topics.name: nanoCMS
topics.purpose: Define nanoCMS as the owner of canonical web structure (#WEB): site hierarchy, pages, routes, navigation metadata and MetaModule placement/bindings, but not MetaModule semantics.

semantics.tree_rule: Site/page structure is explicit and recursively readable.
semantics.placement_rule: MetaModule placement references existing MetaModule identity.
semantics.projection_rule: Breadcrumbs, nav, sitemap and routes are derived from canonical #WEB structure.
semantics.editor_rule: Editor layout/navigation may itself be represented by the same nanoCMS structure.

invariants.rule: Expose, nanoCMS, MetaModules and Editor remain projections/compositions over canonical semantics and never create hidden runtime authority.

hard_gates.condition: route inferred only from filesystem path
MetaModule placement lacks explicit module identity
Editor layout hard-coded outside nanoCMS despite being modeled as canonical site structure
